title.zh: 中央公积金（家属保障保险计划——未受保会员）公告 2019
title.en: Central Provident Fund (Dependants’ Protection Insurance Scheme — Uninsured Member) Notification 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Central Provident Fund (Dependants’ Protection Insurance Scheme — Uninsured Member) Notification 2019.

heading.en: Member with pre-existing incapacity or serious illness

text.en: 2A. For the purpose of section 42(2)(d) of the Act, a member of the Fund is not insured under the Scheme if the member is incapacitated or suffering from serious illness before the date on which any contribution has been paid into the Fund for the member.
